Overview

Daytona Beach is a city in FL with a population of 68,000. World-famous beach with NASCAR racing, bike weeks, and spring break tradition. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 9b growing zone supports Warm to hot — citrus, tropical fruits, year-round growing.
